comments: Each finding shows the WCAG criterion and the EN 301 549 clause where one exists. Reports are in English; axe rule messages are available in 20 languages with --locale. Also published on npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/floorcheck
features: Command-line WCAG 2.2 checker built on axe-core. Adds checks axe does not have (reflow at 320px, focus visible, positive tabindex, looping motion), keeps failures, items for manual review and advice apart, and reports error, bot-check and maintenance pages as not scanned instead of clean. Sitemaps, CI exit codes, Node API. Open source (MIT).
title: floorcheck
